This is the chain-type alignment issue called out as P0-PG-02-C in the audit. Not caused by this stage, not blocking PASS, recorded for the next stage's awareness.

The shadow binary's RPC layer always falls back to hardcoded public RPC endpoints (mainnet.base.org, base.drpc.org, mainnet-preconf.base.org) when chains.base.rpc_primary is empty. The smoke config intentionally leaves rpc_primary empty, but the binary still does startup + periodic public RPC health probes. These are free and read-only; no paid RPC, no signing, no broadcasting. A future task could add a 'no-RPC smoke' mode that disables the default endpoints entirely.

The smoke's safety check is a static string-grep on the captured log. It catches panic / fatal / canary / live / paper / signing / broadcast / mint / swap / bridge keywords. A future hardening could also verify (via cmdline flag) that the shadow binary was indeed built with -tags=shadow, not the default mode or a different build tag.
